# Definition of Ready (required — fill every line, or the gate blocks this PR)

Spec: specs/<feature>/prd.md
Acceptance: specs/<feature>/acceptance.md
Design: specs/<feature>/design.md
Test evidence: <!-- what you ran and the result, e.g. "make net" / "bundle exec rspec" -->
Data impact: <!-- what is persisted or computed, and how -->
Requirement IDs: <!-- trace ID(s), e.g. REQ-001; see tools/trace -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Spec / PRD linked and non-empty
- [ ] Acceptance criteria linked with Given/When/Then scenarios
- [ ] Design plan linked with Approach, Data impact, Risks, Test plan
- [ ] A test covers this change (api/spec/, web/tests/, or e2e/)
- [ ] No placeholder text (TBD / N/A) where a link belongs

> Docs-only and `/assessment`-only changes are exempt from this gate.
